comment: Release notes shown inside the application (Help > What's New, app.whats_new), newest first. Shipped with the program; nothing is fetched.

versions.title: Zene Studio 0.5.0
items: One window: the arrangement in the middle, the browser on the left, the Inspector on the right, the editors and the mixer below.
A new note editor with velocity colours, an expression lane, scale folding and ghost notes.
Themes: a light palette beside dark and high contrast, your own colours (Customise > Theme), and a roomier or touch-sized layout density.
The Window menu: a track manager, a large clock, a tuner, memory locations, saved selections, keep-on-top and window tidying.
Help > Ask: type a question and get the manual sections and commands that answer it - offline.
Settings presets, search and backup (Customise > Settings).
Every action is a named command an agent, a Lua script or a controller can run too, and every edit can be undone.

versions.title: Zene Studio 0.4.0
items: Recording with take lanes and comping, punch in and out, input monitoring.
VST3 and CLAP plug-in editors; plug-in delay compensation.
Focus Desk, start hub and keyboard shortcuts page.
